subject: Trail cleanup update
text: I thought the trail cleanup was Saturday. I checked the app again. The date was wrong. It says Sunday. That explains my confusion. I called the park office. They confirmed Sunday. I need to tell everyone. Can you call the others? Please mention the new start time. It begins at nine. Pack gloves. Pack water. Pack a bag for litter. I will pack snacks. I will pack trash bags. Sorry for the error. I read the calendar fast. I missed the small note. Can you spread the word? I will send a reminder later. Thanks for helping. Your support saves me. I owe you coffee. Tell them soon. Do not wait. You are great.
